messages:
incidents-bot: PAGE — High severity incident detected for tenant 'orchid-health' in VPC vpc-orchid-prod on dedicated pool 'dedicated-east-3'. Symptoms: 503s with backend 'model-unavailable'. Detected ~02:07 UTC. Auto-fallback failed. Paging oncall :rotating_light:

sam_oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Will grab top-level impact & triage. @mel_prodeng can you join?

mel_prodeng: Joining. Quick look: burst of very long contexts from that tenant, spike in KV cache size and worker memory pressure. Seeing OOMs and model unloads on several hosts.

jia_sre: Confirmed evictions on gpu-08, gpu-09, gpu-10. KV cache thrash metrics high. No obvious network packet drops. Looks like local memory exhaustion rather than network. :eyes:

sam_oncall: Mitigation plan (short): 1) isolate tenant to stop noisy-neighbor impact; 2) migrate traffic to ephemeral pool 'ephemeral-orchid-1'; 3) apply per-tenant concurrency caps. Starting step 1 now.

mel_prodeng: Running migration commands and collecting logs.
```shell
rwictl pool migrate --from dedicated-east-3 --to ephemeral-orchid-1 --tenant orchid-health
rwictl node drain --nodes gpu-08,gpu-09,gpu-10
kubectl -n inference logs pod/infer-orchid-abc --tail=200
```

mel_prodeng: Migration in progress, traffic now ~60% to ephemeral-orchid-1, errors dropping to baseline for that tenant. Keeping ~30% to original pool for telemetry.

alex_csm: Looping in customer contact (Orchid Health): @mgranados. We told them we're investigating and will update in 30m. They asked for a breakdown of affected requests and expected timeline for a permanent fix.

sam_oncall: Preparing handoff notes for night oncall in 25m. TL;DR for handoff: suspected memory pressure due to very long contexts from customer's load test; mitigation executed (migration + concurrency cap + node drains); follow-ups required: RCA, KV cache trace, evaluate quantization options and context-length throttles.

ravi_oncall: Ack. I'll take watch in 25m and monitor error rate. Escalate if >1% failures for 10m. Please include rollback steps for migration.

ops_lead: Need customer impact estimate & SLA credit draft. Preliminary numbers: ~2.8k failed requests for Orchid over 45min window. Roughly 0.6% of their daily volume. If SLA is 99.9% monthly, propose 5% credit for incident window. I'll draft calc. :memo:

mel_prodeng: RCA draft (initial):
- Trigger: customer initiated extended load test sending unusually long context sequences starting ~02:03 UTC.
- Failure mode: worker memory exhaustion -> OOMs -> model unloads -> 503 responses.
- Contributing factors: dedicated pool allowed unbounded per-tenant concurrency; no context-length throttling on edge; eviction policy on GPU nodes evicted active processes too aggressively under sustained pressure.
- Immediate mitigation: tenant migration to ephemeral pool, concurrency cap applied, drained affected nodes.
- Short/medium/long-term fixes: add per-tenant context-length and request-size limiter; implement KV cache LRU + telemetry alarm; revise eviction policy to prefer background models.
Will prepare a timeline + logs.

alex_csm: I'll convert the RCA into a customer-facing note and an exec one-pager with impact numbers. Please freeze any config changes to routing/eviction until we sign off postmortem.

sam_oncall: Action items:
- mel_prodeng: postmortem + attach logs by EOD
- jia_sre: full node traces & core dumps -> s3://redwood-incidents/1793501234 (will post link)
- ops_lead: SLA calc & credit proposal
- alex_csm: customer comm + exec note
- ravi_oncall: 2h watch after handoff and confirm rollback steps work

incidents-bot: Incident status -> mitigated :white_check_mark:. Postmortem required. Incident closed at ~03:59 UTC. Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1793501234

sam_oncall: Handoff summary posted to #incidents-review. Leaving the watch to @ravi_oncall. Thanks everyone — please add anything missing to action list. :handshake:
